releaseNotes:
Feature: Cursor agent turn timeout is configurable in Settings (5–180 minutes, default 30)
Fix: Telegram work on the same project no longer closes the Deploy SSH terminal or FTP session
Fix: Arrow keys stay in the Deploy terminal while a file editor is open
Fix: Tab accepts the visible terminal suggestion instead of the shell completion
Fix: Telegram plan files keep Markdown tables and drop Mermaid diagrams
